description: Formalize-first structural gate for bean qbk2 (q-Bessel 2nd-kind quadratic-action binding correction). Constructs the singular 2nd solution g2=w^{-nu} sum d_k w^k of the Hahn-Exton q-Bessel equation (☆), verifies it via the q-Casoratian q-Abel law (param-free normalization) and its w^{-nu} origin singularity, and deduces the 2nd-kind correction is on-shell-EXCLUDED by regularity (off-shell resolvent only). Prunes the qbk2 search before any binding scan. No fit; nothing wired; TIERED.
discipline: formalize-first; no fit; derive-or-refute; TIERED; nothing wired; on-shell binding stays cal-anchored
verdict: GATE RESULT (formalize-first; no fit; nothing wired). The Hahn-Exton q-Bessel 2nd-kind solution g2(w)=w^{-nu} sum d_k w^k is (A) a genuine 2nd solution of the (☆) q-difference equation, (B) independent of g1 with a q-Abel Casoratian D(w)=const*w^{-nu} -- so its normalization is SUBSTRATE-FIXED, adding NO fitted per-block knob (NOT a 7th Delta_lambda ansatz), and (C) SINGULAR ~ w^{-nu} at the substrate origin (the classical Neumann Y_nu ~ x^{-nu}). Because the on-shell binding sum is built from REGULAR-rep Markov matrix coefficients, regularity at the origin EXCLUDES the 2nd-kind solution from the on-shell trace (the same regularity that excludes Y_nu from E_q(2)/SU_q(2) matrix coefficients): the 2nd-kind 'quadratic action' correction is IDENTICALLY ZERO on-shell. It is non-trivial ONLY off-shell, in the q-Bessel Green's function / resolvent G ~ g1(x_<) g2(x_>)/D(x) sourced by the linear -w term of (☆). This PRUNES the qbk2 search: no on-shell binding scan is warranted; any continuation must be an off-shell resolvent with an explicit source. Bar sector: g1 carries both bar parities via Jacobi-Anger; the 2nd-kind enters off-shell paired with g1 through the Casoratian, so it does not define a new independent bar sector. TIERED: (A)(B)(C) PROVED; the off-shell-only conclusion is a structural deduction, not a fit; c_k / Delta_lambda stay cal-anchored.
